description: A browser page with several groups of scatter plots: two plots side by side, a row of four plots, a column of three plots, a small grid of plots, and a single plot on its own.
scenario: Rendered headlessly from the task's own BokehJS build (the state the agent receives) in Chromium at device scale 1.5. Each group is a separate root: a Row of two fixed-frame plots, a Row of four fixed-frame plots with legends, a Column of three fixed-frame plots with different y ranges, a GridBox of three fixed-frame plots, and one standalone figure.
